question: Which home team had lost the fewest matches in the 2016 season?
evidence: home team lost the matches refers to SUBTRACT(home_team_goal, away_team_goal) < 0; 2016 season refers to season = '2015/2016';
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT teamDetails.team_long_name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS __r FROM Match AS matchData INNER JOIN Team AS teamDetails ON matchData.home_team_api_id = teamDetails.team_api_id WHERE matchData.season = '2015/2016' AND matchData.home_team_goal - matchData.away_team_goal < 0 GROUP BY matchData.home_team_api_id) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT teamDetails.team_long_name FROM Match AS matchData INNER JOIN Team AS teamDetails ON matchData.home_team_api_id = teamDetails.team_api_id WHERE matchData.season = '2015/2016' AND matchData.home_team_goal - matchData.away_team_goal < 0 GROUP BY matchData.home_team_api_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1

c.sql: WITH home_losses AS (SELECT t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses FROM "Match" AS m JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name) SELECT team_long_name, losses FROM home_losses WHERE losses = (SELECT MIN(losses) FROM home_losses);

d.request: Which home teams lost the fewest matches in the 2015/2016 season? Return all teams tied for the fewest losses.
d.sql: WITH home_losses AS (SELECT t.team_long_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses FROM "Match" AS m JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name) SELECT team_long_name, losses FROM home_losses WHERE losses = (SELECT MIN(losses) FROM home_losses) ORDER BY team_long_name;

b.request: Which home team or teams had the fewest home losses in the 2015/2016 season, counting matches where home_team_goal < away_team_goal and returning all teams tied for the fewest?
b.sql: WITH home_losses AS (SELECT t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count FROM "Match" AS m JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name) SELECT team_long_name, loss_count FROM home_losses WHERE loss_count = (SELECT MIN(loss_count) FROM home_losses);
